params.2216: [Click for more information on life points]
params.2211:
Your Constitution tells you how healthy your character can be. A character with low Constitution will only have a small number of life points when they're fully healed, whereas a character with a high Constitution can have many more life points.

If you see any red 'hitsplats' during combat, the number shown corresponds to the number of life points lost as a result of that strike.

Blue hitsplats indicate that no damage has been dealt.
Green hitsplats are poison damage (members)
Yellow hitsplats are disease damage (members)
Pink hitsplats show life points restored through healing (while in Daemonheim)
